text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Yaaagh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うっひゃあああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
That was close!
Are you okay?
You're not hurt, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっぶない！
大丈夫？
怪我してない？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, it's you!
Fancy meeting you here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれっ、
{0}くんだ！
奇遇だね！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
No really, I promise! This time, it's an actual coincidence.
I'm as shocked as you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや本当に今回は
正真正銘の偶然だから、
お姉ちゃんビックリしちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: So what brings you all the way out here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何してるの～、
こんなところで？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a new job, huh?
You're delivering mail between Landosol and the farm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅん、
郵便配達のバイト？
それでたまにこの牧場と、
ランドソルを行き来してるんだ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
You sure do take on a lot of odd jobs.
I'm worried about you.
Don't overwork yourself and keel over on me, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろんなバイトをしてるんだね、
{0}くん。
働き過ぎで倒れちゃわないか、
心配だよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Though it's certainly more productive than just
lazing about at home all day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ
家でゴロゴロ寝転がって、
暇を持て余すよりは有意義だろうけど？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Who, me? Well, as you can see,
I came to the farm to practice riding horseback!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
お姉ちゃんはね～、
見てのとおり
この牧場で乗馬の練習をしてるの！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
But then you came along,
and I nearly ran you over...
Oh, my blood ran cold!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっかり通りすがりの、
{0}くんを轢きそうになって……
ひやっとしたよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Because of all my guild work,
I have to travel all around the country at times.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
私はギルドの仕事の関係で、
全国の津々浦々を飛び回ったりするからさ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I thought horseback riding could be useful,
so I'm trying to learn!
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬に乗れると便利かな、
と思って練習中なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: After all, it's hard to get to those faraway places by foot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遠方だと、
徒歩で移動するのもなかなか大変だしね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
See, we tend to run a lean operation,
so why shell out for a whole cart
if we could just rent a single horse instead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちは、
少人数で行動することがおおいから……
馬車を丸ごとよりも、
馬を一頭だけ借りたほうが安上がりでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like...
I could take you home on him, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
良かったら帰り道……
お姉ちゃんが、馬で送ってあげようか？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
My contract with the farm
says I have the horse for a whole month,
so I can ride him home and everything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
牧場と契約してね、
馬を一ヶ月だけレンタルしたから。
乗って帰れるんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I'm one of those people
who picks things up right away.
Those mountain roads will be a cinch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん、
わりと何でもすぐに上達するほうだから。
山道でも安心だよ～？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: So come on up! Go on, don't be shy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
遠慮せずに、
乗って乗って♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
おいで……♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Now, grab on real tight to me.
Otherwise, you might get thrown off the horse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっかり、
お姉ちゃんに掴まってね。
振り落とされたら、怪我しちゃうから。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Go on, tighter!
Get nice and snug!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほらっ、
もっと強く抱きしめて～♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: All right, let's ride! Giddyup!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
行っちゃうよ～！
出発進行♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Eek?!
Hey, {0}? You're glowing again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ……？
{0}くん、
また何か光ってるよ！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
It's so bright!
Shoot, the mysterious light is startling the horse...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
眩しい～！
やばっ、
馬が謎の輝きに驚いて暴れてる……！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. Isn't this fun?
Just a nice day out with your favorite sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっへっへ。
嬉しいなっ、
姉弟で仲良くお買い物～♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I woke up early
just to come wake you up and everything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく朝早くに、
お姉ちゃんが起こしに行ったのに……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: But you were already awake before I got there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
ちゃんと自分で起きてたのは残念だったけど。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Darn it!
I really wanted to wake you up today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぇ～！
お姉ちゃんが、
起こしてあげたかったのにな～？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I guess you're a strong, independent man now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは、
もう一人前の男の子に成長しちゃったんだね？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
It's a good thing, but it still makes me sad.
'Cause now you can live just fine on your own...
No need for your big sister to be around anymore...
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬉しいけど、
寂しいな。
もうお姉ちゃんなんかいなくても、
{0}くんは立派に生きていけるんだね……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I'm just used goods now...
A sister nobody needs...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は用済みだね、
要らないお姉ちゃんだね……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's not true?
You still need me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そんなことない？
私、
必要？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right!
Oh, I'm so glad you're so honest, {0}!
Let's stay together foreeever! Heehee! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよねっ、
んもう{0}くんの正直者！
ずうっと
一緒にいようね、
えへへ♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Oopsie-daisy.
Let's not make
too much of a scene in here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おっとっと。
お店のなかで騒いじゃ、
駄目だよね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Do you want me to carry some of those bags?
I got a little carried away and bought too much.
It's gotta be heavy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
荷物、
ちょっとはお姉ちゃんが持とうか？
私テンションあがって買い過ぎちゃったから、
重いでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
You sure you're okay?
Oh, right. You're all big and strong now.
I guess I didn't need to ask.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫？
そっか、
{0}くんは力持ちなんだ……
男の子だもんね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Welllll then, I'll have a bit more faith in my big,
strong brother and buy something even heavier next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉし。
じゃあ強く成長したという{0}くんを信用して、
次はもっと重いものを買うよ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I really want some new cookware!
Let's see what they've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
食器とか調理器具とかが欲しいんだ～、
そのへんを見て廻ろう♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I see...
So you broke your rice bowl recently, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむふむ？
{0}くん、
こないだお茶碗を割っちゃったんだ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Well, now's the perfect opportunity to replace it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
ついでだし買っていきなよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me.
I'll pick out a really nice one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんが、
イイカンジのやつを選んであげるね♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Let's see, you've liked light blue ever since you were little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
昔から水色が好きだったよね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
So what do you think of these?
Or maybe you'd prefer the Tower Rangers one?
choice_data_list: I want to find one on my own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これとか、
いいんじゃない？
それとも、
この戦隊ものの絵柄のやつ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Aww, what?
We've really gotta get you to be more autonomous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？
{0}くん、
相変わらず主体性がないなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but wait!
Maybe this just means you trust my judgment wholeheartedly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん！
お姉ちゃんのセンスを、
全面的に信用してくれてるってことだよね！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
I'll pick something a bit less haphazardly.
Hmm... How about this one?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ……
もうちょっと、
真面目に選ぼうかな。
う～む、
これかな？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
No, that's probably too big for your hands. This one?
Um... Umm... Ummm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
{0}くんの、
手のひらのサイズから考えて
こっち……？
う～むむむ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's your bowl,
so you'll pick it yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？
自分で使うやつだから、
自分で選びたいの？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you little stinker!
You've never been able to decide on these things!
You always had me pick everything for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
生意気～！
{0}くんったら優柔不断なくせに～、
昔から何でもお姉ちゃんが選んであげたのにな？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
*giggle* Hey, look.
Notice all these young-looking couples around?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふっふっふ。
ねぇねぇ、
周りに新婚さんっぽいカップルがちらほらいるね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
They must be buying supplies for married life!
Do you think we look like we're doing the same thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
愛の食器選びだね～、
私たちも
夫婦に見えたりするのかな。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure someday...
You'll be in a place like this
shopping with your real wife.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんも、
そのうち……
奥さんと、
こういうところにお買い物にきたりするんだろうね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Probably buying his-and-her teacups together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お揃いの、
夫婦茶碗を選んじゃったりして。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I know you.
You're bound to find someone really special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫。
{0}くんなら、
絶対に良いひとと巡り会えるよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're my precious little brother.
You have to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてったって、
お姉ちゃんの自慢の弟だもん♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I feel like it was only yesterday
you were this tiny little thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ。
ついこの間まで、
{0}くんはあんなにちっちゃかったのに……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
But everyone has to leave the nest someday.
Just thinking about it tears me apart!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつかは巣立って行っちゃうんだね、
想像しただけでジ～ンとしちゃう。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, we probably won't be able to hang out
every day. Not like we do now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしたらもう今みたいに、
しょっちゅう会えなくなっちゃうんだろうね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
I know it's gonna happen,
but I'm still kind of sad about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないことだけど、
やっぱり
ちょっと寂しいな。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
But don't you worry, {0}!
Don't you worry at all!
You'll never have to miss me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも大丈夫だよ、{0}くん！
安心してっ！
寂しがる必要なんてないの！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far you might go,
my love for you will never die. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれだけ遠く離れても、
お姉ちゃんの愛は
永遠に不滅だからねっ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: All right, that's enough of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I knew this already,
but you two sure are close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつも思うけど、
あんたたちって仲良しよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You know, even blood-related siblings
tend to stop being so clingy after puberty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それこそ血の繋がった姉弟でも、
思春期になればそんなにベタベタしなくなるのに。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'd call it a little abnormal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けっこう、
常軌を逸してる気がするわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Shizuru seems determined
to keep on being your \"big sister,\" but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シズルちゃんはあくまで、
『お姉ちゃん』っていう立場を崩さないけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Is that really all she wants to be?
I kiiinda get the feeling there's something more to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとに、
それだけなのかしらね？
な～んか、
他の気持ちも含まれてる気がするなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Though I don't think she's fully aware of it either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本人もたぶん、
自覚してはいないんだろうけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
What about you?
Do you only see Shizuru
as your nice older sister who looks after you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたは、どうなの？
シズルちゃんのこと、
ほんとに世話焼きのお姉ちゃんとしてだけ見てるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really.
Believe me, I'm not gonna tell you how to live your life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいけどね、
あんたたちの人生にまでは
口をださないわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I just think that the longer you stay like this,
the worse it's going to get for you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもたぶん現状維持をしてるだけだと、
そのうちドツボに嵌まる気がするわよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Oh geez. Looks like I picked a bad time to interrupt.
Better wake up or you're gonna fall off that horse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと。
今回はちょっと間が悪かったわね、
さっさと起きないと
馬から落ちて大怪我しちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Time to open up your eyes, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
手早く目覚めなさい、
{0}。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And when you do...
why don't you give your big sister
a great, big hug?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それであんたの、
大事な『お姉ちゃん』のことを……
しっかり、
抱きしめてあげるのよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Oh geez! {0}, are you awake?
Oh, thank goodness!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
っとっと？
{0}くん、起きた？
良かったぁ～♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! You really scared me,
conking out on me like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んもう。
急にガクンって脱力するから、
驚いちゃった……
ぞっ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Luckily we weren't going too fast,
so you wouldn't have gotten too hurt if you fell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだそんなに速度はだしてないから、
落ちても軽傷で済むだろうけど。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
But if you got trampled underfoot
you could even have died!
Please be careful... You really scared me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬に踏まれたりしたら、
下手すれば死んじゃうからね。
気をつけてね～、
心配だなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
If you're not feeling well,
I have a rope I can use to tie us together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれなら落馬しないように、
お姉ちゃんと{0}くんを
縄で縛りつけちゃう？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that might not be too bad.
Not too bad at all! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それって、
何だかとっても幸せな状態な気がするよ……♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Eep!
text_block_list.orig_text: わひゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Wha— Huh?
{0}?
You're squeezing me a bit too tight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
あれっ？
{0}くん？
そ、
そんなに強く抱きしめちゃ駄目だよ～？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
It kinda hurts...
What's gotten into you?
You little softy...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと痛いよ、
どうしたの急にっ？
甘えん坊さん……！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're just holding tight so you don't fall off... 
aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ
馬から落ちないように、
しっかり抱きついてきた……
んだよね？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can't think of any other reason.
Y-you kinda startled me, grabbing me out of the blue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
他に考えられないよねっ？
と、
突然ギュッてされたから
驚いちゃったよ～？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten a lot stronger.
In fact, I'd say you've grown a lot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
ちからが強くなったんだね。
ううん、
おおきくなったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. I know you have amnesia,
so there's a lot you've forgotten.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
{0}くんは記憶喪失で、
いろいろ忘れちゃってるけど。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
But I definitely think
you're the same old {0} I've always loved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも{0}くんは、
{0}くんなんだなぁ～
って思うよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
See, we used to go home together like this a lot.
You'd be so exhausted from playing
that I'd have to carry you piggy-back all the way home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
昔も、
よくこうやってふたりで帰ったよね。
遊び疲れた{0}くんを、
私がおんぶしてさ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't think I could do that now, but...
You can still count on me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今じゃもう、
{0}くんを背負うのは大変だけど……
お姉ちゃんに、
任せてね。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
You can always hold me.
Always lean on me.
Always ask me for help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつだって抱きついて、
寄りかかって、
甘えてくれていいんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
That's what gives me life.
It brings me joy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが私の生きがいで、
幸せだから。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Because I love you.
My wonderful, kind,
sweet {0}. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁい好きだよ。
大事な大事な、
私のかわいい{0}くん……♪
